title: The two-point inequality
statement:
Let $a, b \in \bbr$, let $1 \le p \le 2$, and let $\rho \ge 0$ satisfy $\rho^2 \le p - 1$. Then
\[
  \big(a^2 + \rho^2 b^2\big)^{1/2} \le \left(\frac{|a+b|^p + |a-b|^p}{2}\right)^{1/p}.
\]
replaced:
For $1 \le p \le 2$, all $a, b \in \bbr$, and $\rho \ge 0$ with $\rho^2 \le p-1$,
\[
  \big(a^2 + \rho^2 b^2\big)^{1/2} \le \Big(\frac{|a+b|^p + |a-b|^p}{2}\Big)^{1/p}.
\]
